title: Restore rename undo button visibility
summary: Restored the Rename page Undo Last Apply control by preserving the backend undo manifest from successful apply results and wiring the button to POST /api/rename/undo with confirm_undo=true.
reason: Successful rename apply results could show progress evidence while the Apply Status panel still said no undo was available because the WebView never stored the returned undo_manifest or attached the undo button command flow.
behavior_before: After a successful rename apply with an undo manifest, the apply evidence could render 100% complete while the UI showed No undo available and the Undo Last Apply button stayed hidden or disabled.
behavior_after: After a successful rename apply with an undo manifest, the Apply Status panel shows the renamed/applied count, the Undo Last Apply button is visible and enabled, and clicking it calls the backend undo route once with the manifest and strict confirmation.
tests_added: tests/webview/test_webview_browser_rename_smoke.py undo-button visibility assertions after apply result
rollback_plan: Revert the renameView.js undo state/handler additions and the focused WebView/static test assertions; backend rename apply/undo behavior is unchanged by this packet.
